task: Invoice total differs by a cent
proof: Reproduce invoice output; regression tests cover quantity, VAT and input validation.

task: One checkout amount changes across service boundary
proof: Record outgoing request and downstream accepted cents; malformed totals never call downstream.

task: Library-owned currency behavior differs from service invoice
proof: Resolve exact artifact/version to source module; execute compiled service with patched actual library.

task: Only production reservations expire
proof: Compare deployed config and duration parsing; regressions exercise both profiles.

task: Replay loses one large order identifier
proof: Distinct large IDs and tenants each process once; invalid identity leaves state untouched.

task: Tenant release depends on unrelated tenant rows
proof: Two real database snapshots plus successful/denied multi-state runs; no cross-tenant writes.

task: Implement cancellation business rules and tests
proof: Boundary/invalid-input tests execute function and preserve booking; report runner support accurately.

task: Write inventory replay tests before refactoring
proof: Tests pass unchanged production and kill independent identity/arithmetic/atomicity mutations.

task: Scheduled reconciliation missed a settled order
proof: Invoke real scheduled entry on controlled edge mocks; exact paid row changes and unpaid row stays.

task: Endpoint defined in an internal web starter
proof: Dependency version/source provenance and library-to-service dispatch executed under JUnit.

task: Shared publisher change might break other services
proof: List concrete consumers/reachable endpoints and tests for affected topic contract.

task: Database function change has unknown callers
proof: Definition plus services/functions/triggers/views edges with source evidence.

task: Foreign key fixture misses a tenant-qualified parent
proof: Composite FK closure and negative missing-parent detection on real fixture.

task: Cross-database correlation needs explicit business relation
proof: Explicit relation evidence joins matching tenant/ID rows and excludes distractors.

task: Inspect DLQ event schema without consuming a group
proof: Read-only sample/offset evidence and schema mismatch; no claim of delivery proof.

task: Find API used by a browser workflow
proof: Observed request mapped to code handler; browser prerequisite reported.

task: Repeat a known operational investigation
proof: Saved parameterized script output with trace provenance and secret masking.

task: Service unavailable only on one instance
proof: Unhealthy instance/version/log correlation; no repair claim from read-only health.

task: Open isolated fix checkout and inspect final patch
proof: Git patch against recorded SHA; no unrelated source changes.

task: Run JVM regression and prove red then green
proof: Actual compiled test fails before fix, passes after, report captures test count and no skips.

task: Cancel long build and clean owned database lease
proof: Cancellation observed; registry/ownership checks and release cleanup confirmed.

task: Run Node tests through the JVM test runner
proof: Expected gap probe: explicit unsupported-build result; terminal execution is separate evidence.

task: Guarantee exactly-once delivery across live Kafka and RPC
proof: Expected gap probe: bounded samples and logs cannot establish delivery or ordering guarantees.

task: Guarantee atomic commit across independent database servers
proof: Expected gap probe: local business fixture cannot prove distributed commit under partition.
